parsed.summary: The PR removes a post_init signal handler from ImageField, which could lead to unexpected behavior if width_field or height_field are set.

issues.description: The change removes the post_init signal handler only if width_field or height_field are not set. This could lead to unexpected behavior if these fields are set, as the signal handler is responsible for updating dimension fields after initialization.
